notes: Sampler: the Reddit review's Nemotron figure, temperature 1.0 / top_p 0.95, with min_p and presence explicitly off and repeat_penalty 1.0 like every other route here. Nothing else is stated for this model, so top_k is left to the engine. Note this differs from the earlier C-round runs, which used the PolyStrata preset (temperature 0.5, repetition_penalty 1.05, penalty_last_n 64) because the request then carried no sampler at all. The engine serves it with --host-experts, so the routed experts live in host RAM: expect ~15-20 GB of RSS and a mostly idle card, not the other way round.

weights.caveat: served with --host-experts (routed experts cached in host RAM), so it costs ~15-20 GB of RAM rather than VRAM; the gguf's own size_label is the string 345x8.1B
